title: #WeAreNATO - The Romanian Search & Rescue dog master, B-Roll
description:
Romanian Search & Rescue team member Marin-Viorel Porosanu trains his dog “Nord” to find victims left stuck, wounded or unconscious.

Meet the men and women who work every day for NATO.
From soldiers to scientists, cyber experts to civilian
emergency responders, NATO members are committed to supporting and protecting each other.

The footage was filmed during the disaster response exercise organised by NATO’s Euro-Atlantic Disaster Response Coordination Centre (EADRCC) in Bosnia and Herzegovina, September 2017.

It shows how Romanian Urban Search and Rescue Team member Marin-Viorel Porosanu trains his dog “Nord” to find victims who are stuck, wounded or unconscious.

Contains:
-	broll of Porosanu training his dog to obey
-	broll of Porosanu training his dog to search and rescue a victim
-	Soundbites of Porosanu.

“Since I was a small kid, I have loved dogs. I said, “this I have to do for all my life”. For 21 years I have been doing this and I will do it for 100 more.
We’ve been through a lot of adventures together, on a lot of missions. The dog must have complete confidence in me. Because if he doesn’t trust me, I cannot train him.  I will have his back. He will trust me like one of his own. ”
